title: Aromatic Light Korean Chicken Wrap
description: A diabetic-friendly Korean dish featuring fermented shoyu-koji and ssam-wrap, perfect for a post-workout meal
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together shoyu-koji, gochujang, soy sauce, and brown sugar to make the marinade.
Add the chicken breast strips to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the ssam-wrap leaves by rinsing them with cold water and patting them dry with paper towels.
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
Assemble the wraps by placing a few slices of chicken onto a ssam-wrap leaf, followed by a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds, chopped green onions, and a drizzle of the remaining marinade.
Garnish with additional green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
